sql:
WITH fifo_inv AS (
    SELECT product_id, id, location_id, qty, purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased ASC, qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inventory_with_dims
),
picking_with_fifo AS (
    SELECT pl.product_id, pl.qty as pick_qty, fi.qty as inv_qty,
           CASE WHEN pl.qty < fi.qty THEN pl.qty ELSE fi.qty END as picked_qty,
           1.0 * CASE WHEN pl.qty < fi.qty THEN pl.qty ELSE fi.qty END / pl.qty as pick_pct
    FROM picking_line pl
    JOIN fifo_inv fi ON pl.product_id = fi.product_id AND fi.rn = 1
)
SELECT p.name as product_name, AVG(pick_pct) as avg_pick_pct
FROM picking_with_fifo pwf
JOIN products p ON pwf.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name
